heldRowFollowup.minimalConstruction: Dedicated fresh session in same legitimate fixture, actual interrupted transport after read/send/RELEASE. Parent opens a genuine separate PG Connection, BEGIN and SELECT session_id FROM studio_guided_sessions WHERE session_id=? FOR UPDATE before interrupting caller. heldRowFollowup.observation: Require actual PG Lock wait while helper has no terminal commit, bytes/chars erased and counters fixed. Observe for a declared short finite window; caller remaining blocked is evidence of lock dependency, not a test failure against an invented5s production contract.
heldRowFollowup.release: ROLLBACK real locker, then require actual healthy reconciliation UNKNOWN/audit commit and restored interrupt with no new read/send. Unreleased row/pool bounds cannot be credited by a released-lock observation.
heldRowFollowup.futureBoundDecision: Before claiming a general stop/cleanup deadline, separately inspect/capture effective TransactionTemplate timeout, driver connect/login/socket/network timeouts, JdbcTemplate querytimeout and server statement_timeout/lock_timeout using a safe timeout-only whitelist. Any bounded reconciliation production change needs independent design/release; no global timeout/outbox/background authority inferred here.
heldRowFollowup.cleanup: Always rollback/close locker in finally; do not leave a JDBC waiter holding testprocess alive. If cleanup release is required after watchdog, record probe fail/block and recovery separately.
